verdict.rationale: ElevenLabs runs an official hosted MCP server. Claude or any other MCP client can connect to it and create, configure and manage agents through natural language, with nothing to install locally. This is server-side MCP support; the separate ability of agents to connect to external MCP servers is client-side and was not credited here. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and documented detail on the exposed tool set and authentication flow.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: connect the hosted MCP server to Claude or any other MCP client to create and manage agents through natural language
an assistant such as Claude can create, configure, and manage the agents in your workspace through natural language, with nothing to install or run locally
ElevenLabs Agents are managed either through the ElevenAgents dashboard, the ElevenLabs API, the Agents CLI or the hosted MCP server.
